root.label: Hinson votes for September procedural motions blocking Epstein bill

events.label: Hinson votes for September procedural motions blocking Epstein bill

slots.name: vote on Epstein files
slots.sentence: We found that Hinson also voted with the majority for other “previous question” motions in July 2025 and September 2025 that stopped a stand-alone bill on the Epstein files from being brought to the House floor.

slots.name: discharge petition signature
slots.sentence: And she didn’t sign a discharge petition led by Rep. Thomas Massie, R-Ky., that eventually obtained enough signatures to force a floor vote on the Epstein files’ release.
